purpose: satisfy the plan's require_l0_swept_area_clear preflight for experiment 881677a0, whose wording is 'confirm the actual L0 swept volume is free of cables, fixtures and obstacles; a cable is a blocker only if it lies in that swept area'

which_leg_is_L0.how_established: the camera tracker reports leg_zero_azimuth_body_deg 210 for L3 and 270 for L4, i.e. 60 deg spacing, which puts L0 at 30 deg; this matches mesh_mujoco/hexapod_mesh.xml's own L0_yaw body pos (0.087, 0.05) -> atan2 = 29.9 deg
which_leg_is_L0.role: front-right leg of the front pair (L0/L5), not a middle leg

swept_volume_computed_from_the_protocol.method: read directly from this run's own reviewed protocol (protocol_hash 8709926b4c01), not carried over
swept_volume_computed_from_the_protocol.l0_yaw_joint_j0: constant [0] in every one of 1560 rows, so the leg does NOT sweep laterally at all
swept_volume_computed_from_the_protocol.foot_path: a single radial line segment along L0's fixed azimuth
swept_volume_computed_from_the_protocol.verdict: a ~60 mm long, ~15 mm deep sliver directly along the leg L0 is already resting on

why_a_floor_cable_cannot_be_in_this_volu.statement: the deepest commanded point of the whole trajectory is 65.95 mm above the plane the feet contact, so a cable LYING ON THE FLOOR is not in the swept volume by construction. Only an object standing more than ~66 mm tall directly beneath the resting L0 leg could enter it, and the frames below are checked for exactly that.

visual_inspection.illumination: mean luma 49.8 (robot-1/cam0), 23.0 (robot-3/cam1), 24.4 (robot-2/cam2). This is a MATERIALLY BRIGHTER arena than every prior member of this family: the L1 run recorded 24.9 / 4.6 / 4.4 and the L2/L5 runs matched it. Arena lighting has been restored since 2026-09-10T05:06Z.
visual_inspection.what_the_frames_show: all six legs splayed straight out and belly-resting flat on the floor, feet down, chassis flat, no leg standing, no tip or lean, no person or hands in frame. The floor immediately around every foot -- L0's included -- is bare carpet. Cabling is present in the arena and some of it is the robot's own tether, but every strand visible near the robot lies FLAT ON THE FLOOR; nothing stands proud of the floor anywhere inside leg reach, in any of the three views.
visual_inspection.scope_note: all six legs were checked rather than L0 alone: it is a strictly stronger claim and does not depend on identifying L0 in the image, which these views cannot do directly (L0's coxa tag 1 is not visible to any calibrated camera at this pose).
visual_inspection.improvement_over_the_L1_run: the L1 record's honest limit was that at its illumination the frames could not resolve a thin cable and the tag tracker reported 'tags: none' on all three views. At this illumination cables ARE resolvable and the tracker resolves 10-14 tags per view, so this inspection is direct evidence rather than geometry alone.

supporting_evidence_that_the_volume_is_f.free_air_currents_on_this_identical_comm: the L1/L2/L5 members ran this byte-identical commanded hip/knee path on this rig and peaked at 0.006-0.039 A against the 0.75 A runner trip; anything in the path would load the joint far above that
supporting_evidence_that_the_volume_is_f.backstop_if_wrong: the on-robot runner's real-time interlocks (0.75 A over 3 polls, 3.0 A ceiling, tracking error vs the slewed reference, 3 consecutive missed reads) limp the robot on an unexpected force, and this run enforces the /api/errors stop live at 1 Hz on the bus-free path
